title: strobilanthes pauciflora
intro: Strobilanthes pauciflora, commonly known as the "Gurhal" or "Gulmohar" tree, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia and Australia, belonging to the family Acanthaceae. The health benefits of Strobilanthes pauciflora include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, inflammation, and digestive issues due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Strobilanthes pauciflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
